title: Duplicate Advisory: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-109478 - ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability
description:
## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-r3qf-p3jm-8h4p. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
Inefficient algorithmic complexity in ASP.NET Core allows an unauthorized attacker to deny service over a network.
